jobs.description:
Introduction
 Help shape the future of healthcare AI, where innovation meets trust.
 At CERN, you will develop cutting-edge AI solutions that help prevent disease, improve prediction, and deliver trustworthy healthcare insights. You will work on technologies that make it possible to unlock the value of sensitive data without ever moving or exposing it, enabling collaboration where privacy is essential.
 As part of this role, you will help develop and deploy CAFEIN® , CERN's federated AI platform powering major European healthcare initiatives, including UMBRELLA and AIM-SAFE . You will design advanced federated learning algorithms and secure distributed AI systems that allow models to learn from data across institutions while keeping the data exactly where it belongs.
 Recognised as a lighthouse example of "data stays, AI collaborates" , CAFEIN® combines state-of-the-art federated learning with CERN's unique strengths in trust, open science, GDPR compliance, and international collaboration. The result is a pioneering framework that is redefining how AI can advance healthcare while safeguarding privacy.
 Join us to build AI that learns globally, protects locally, and improves lives.
 Functions

• Develop and test federated learning software and algorithms.

• Implement and evaluate privacy-preserving techniques, including differential privacy and homomorphic encryption.

• Develop tools to optimise data ingestions and assess the quality of data and images.

• Design and run machine-learning experiments using programming languages like Python with libraries as TensorFLow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.

• Analyse data using statistical methods and visualisation for exploratory data analysis (EDA).

• Implement and benchmark state-of-the-art machine-learning methods, optimising federated learning for utility, communication efficiency, energy use and scalability.

• Design and deploy Internet of Things (IoT)-based federated learning architectures.

Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Machine Learning, Computer Science or Data Science or a related field.

Experience:

• Demonstrated experience developing and deploying federated learning solutions in real-world environments.

• Proficiency in federated learning techniques, including aggregation algorithms, communication and network architecture, security and privacy features.

• Hands on experience with network security, including certificates, encryption, access control, authorisation, and authentication.

• Proven experience in coordinating or technically leading machine-learning deployments.

• Excellent knowledge and hands on experience with software life-cycle tools and procedures (proficiency with Git and GitLab).

• Excellent knowledge of programming techniques and languages: python, deep learning framework (e.g. TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, Jax or scikit-learn).

• Experience in data analysis in a health care environment would be an asset.
 Technical competencies:

• Knowledge and application of software life-cycle tools and procedures.

• Knowledge of programming techniques and languages.

• Testing, diagnosing and optimisation of software.

• Knowledge of best practices for developing secure software.

• Administration of computing systems, upgrades, application of security patches, system and data migrations, backup and recovery.
 Behavioural competencies:

• Achieving Results: delivering high quality work on time and fulfilling expectations.

• Solving Problems: identifying, defining and assessing problems, taking action to address them.

• Working in Teams: cooperating constructively with others in the pursuit of team goals; balancing personal goals with team goals.

• Communicating Effectively: ensuring that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.

• Learning and Sharing Knowledge: sharing knowledge and expertise freely and willingly with others; coaching others to ensure knowledge transfer.
 Language skills:
 Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Al CERN, svilupperai soluzioni AI all'avanguardia che aiutano a prevenire le malattie, migliorare la predizione e fornire informazioni sanitarie affidabili. Introduction
Help shape the future of healthcare AI, where innovation meets trust.
At CERN, you will develop cutting-edge AI solutions that help prevent disease, improve prediction, and deliver trustworthy healthcare insights. You will work on technologies that make it possible to unlock the value of sensitive data without ever moving or exposing it, enabling collaboration where privacy is essential.
As part of this role, you will help develop and deploy CAFEIN® , CERN's federated AI platform powering major European healthcare initiatives, including UMBRELLA and AIM-SAFE . You will design advanced federated learning algorithms and secure distributed AI systems that allow models to learn from data across institutions while keeping the data exactly where it belongs.
Recognised as a lighthouse example of "data stays, AI collaborates" , CAFEIN® combines state-of-the-art federated learning with CERN's unique strengths in trust, open science, GDPR compliance, and international collaboration. The result is a pioneering framework that is redefining how AI can advance healthcare while safeguarding privacy.
Join us to build AI that learns globally, protects locally, and improves lives.

• Analyse data using statistical methods and visualisation for exploratory data analysis (EDA).

• Knowledge and application of software life-cycle tools and procedures.

• Knowledge of programming techniques and languages.

The ATLAS experiment constructs a new silicon tracking detector, the ATLAS Inner Tracker (ITk). In particular, the CERN team focuses on the development of the Pixel Outer Barrel. The responsibilities relate to the type-1 services as well as test equipment for quality control and electrical testing of detector structures and the final detector integration.
 Your responsibilities:

• Type-1 power and data reception activities.

• T1UT (custom test equipment) user support.

• Quality control testing of custom cable assemblies for the detector, with a focus on type-1 data.

• Type-1 environmental cable production testing and supervision, including commissioning after installation during detector construction.

• Electronics testing and development support.

• Software development support.
 Your profile:

• Experience in the design of PCBs, their production and verification/debugging.

• Experience in programming microcontrollers.

• Hands-on experience in soldering and handling of electrical equipment.

• Experience in writing technical reports, user documentation and manuals.
 Skills:

• PCB design software, preferably Altium or KiCad.

• Programming in C/C++ and Python.

• Ability to operate multimeters, oscilloscopes and a VNA.

• Demonstrating flexibility: adapting quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.

• Achieving results: delivering high-quality work on time and fulfilling expectations; being rigorous and producing quality results at first attempt.

• Working in a mixed team of engineers, technicians and physicists.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Electronics Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .

L'esperimento ATLAS costruisce un nuovo rivelatore di tracciamento del silicio, il Tracker Interno ATLAS (ITk). In particolare, il team CERN si concentra sullo sviluppo del Pixel Outer Barrel. Le responsabilità si riferiscono ai servizi di tipo-1 e alle apparecchiature di prova per il controllo della qualità e il test elettrico delle strutture dei rivelatori e l'integrazione dei rivelatori finali.
Le tue responsabilità:

• Tipo-1 attività di alimentazione e ricezione dati.

• Supporto utente T1UT (attrezzatura di prova personalizzata).

• Test di controllo di qualità dei gruppi cavi personalizzati per il rivelatore, con un focus sui dati di tipo-1.

• Test e supervisione della produzione di cavi ambientali tipo-1, inclusa la messa in servizio dopo l'installazione durante la costruzione del rivelatore.

• Test di elettronica e supporto allo sviluppo.

• Supporto per lo sviluppo del software.
Il tuo profilo:

• Esperienza nella progettazione di PCB, la loro produzione e verifica/debug.

• Esperienza nella programmazione dei microcontrollori.

• Esperienza pratica nella saldatura e nella movimentazione di apparecchiature elettriche.

• Esperienza nella scrittura di report tecnici, documentazione utente e manuali.
Competenze:

• PCB software di progettazione, preferibilmente Altium o KiCad.

• Programmazione in C/C++ e Python.

• Capacità di operare multimetri, oscilloscopi e VNA.

• Dimostrare flessibilità: adattare rapidamente e con risorse a spostare le priorità e i requisiti.

• Ottenere risultati: fornire lavoro di alta qualità nel tempo e soddisfare le aspettative; essere rigorosi e produrre risultati di qualità al primo tentativo.

• Lavorare in un team misto di ingegneri, tecnici e fisici.

• Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese.
Criteri di ammissibilità:

• Sei un cittadino di uno Stato membro del CERN o di uno Stato membro associato .

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Engineering Department (EN) pushes back the limits of technology so that physicists can carry out their research. Within the Electrical Engineering (EL) group of the EN department, you will join the Maintenance and Operation (MO) section, which operates and maintains CERN's electrical distribution network.
Your responsibilities

• Contribute to the management of electrical equipment throughout its lifecycle, from procurement and installation to maintenance activities.

• Manage supply contracts for low-voltage switchboards: coordinate with suppliers and follow up on orders, deliveries, warranties and after-sales services.

• Prepare technical specifications and tender documents and contribute to the correspondent procurement activities.

• Contribute to define and improve equipment data models in CERN's Computerised Maintenance Management System (CMMS), so that technical information, drawings and as-built documentation are organised and kept up to date.

• Coordinate and follow up on site surveys, from data collection and verification to process and update the corresponding information in the CMMS.

• Work with maintenance managers to define preventive and corrective maintenance activities in the CMMS, including maintenance task plans, standard work orders, required resources and spare parts.

• Support engineers, technicians and contractors in using the CMMS through training, user guides and technical assistance.

• Contribute to developing dashboards and KPIs that monitor maintenance activities, equipment performance and data quality.

• Collaborate with the Asset Management team to improve and harmonise equipment data and work management processes across equipment families in the CMMS.
More information here .
Your profile

• Good knowledge of electrical assets such as transformers and MV/LV switchgear.

• First experience with, or a strong interest in, Computerised Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS).

• Good understanding of project management and procurement processes.

• Familiarity with technical documentation, specifications and engineering drawings.
Skills

• Strong interest in electrical equipment, its lifecycle and maintenance processes.

• Interest in procurement and contract management, with the ability to communicate effectively with different stakeholders and follow up on commitments.

• Willingness to learn and to help improve existing methods and processes.

• Structured approach to work, with strong attention to detail.

• Good organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks and manage responsibilities.

• Positive and collaborative attitude, with strong teamwork and communication skills.

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Electrical/Industrial Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants without University degree are not eligible.

• Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

• Coordonner et suivre les enquêtes sur les sites, de la collecte et de la vérification des données au traitement et à la mise à jour de l'information correspondante dans le SGCM.

• Collaborer avec les gestionnaires de l'entretien pour définir les activités d'entretien préventif et correctif dans le SGCM, y compris les plans des tâches d'entretien, les ordres de travail normalisés, les ressources requises et les pièces de rechange.

• Aider les ingénieurs, les techniciens et les entrepreneurs à utiliser le SMCM par la formation, les guides d'utilisation et l'assistance technique.

• Contribuer à l'élaboration de tableaux de bord et d'IPK qui surveillent les activités d'entretien, la performance de l'équipement et la qualité des données.

• Collaborer avec l'équipe de gestion d'actifs afin d'améliorer et d'harmoniser les données sur l'équipement et les processus de gestion du travail dans les familles d'équipement du CMMS.

• Bonne connaissance des actifs électriques tels que les transformateurs et les commutateurs MV/LV.

• Première expérience ou intérêt pour les systèmes informatisés de gestion de la maintenance (CMMS).

• Bonne compréhension des processus de gestion de projet et d'approvisionnement.

• Connaissance de la documentation technique, des spécifications et des dessins techniques.
Compétences

• Intérêt pour la gestion des achats et des marchés, avec la capacité de communiquer efficacement avec les différents intervenants et de suivre les engagements.

• Anglais ou français parlé et écrit, avec un engagement à apprendre l'autre langue.

jobs.description:
As an Experienced Project Graduate, you will contribute to materials characterisation and qualification activities supporting a wide range of CERN projects and technologies.
 Your responsibilities will include supporting, planning and executing studies on materials and components, covering materials procurement, fabrication and assembly qualification, as well as overseeing quality control activities for the construction of particle accelerators.
 Working within the Materials & Metrology team, you will investigate the microstructure, chemical composition, properties and failure mechanisms of metallic and other engineering materials using the section's advanced characterisation capabilities, including light microscopy, Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM), microanalysis, X-ray diffraction (XRD), hardness testing and instrumented indentation.
 You will also perform mechanical testing at both ambient and cryogenic temperatures, including fracture toughness assessments, and conduct failure analyses when required.
 Your responsibilities:

• Investigate the behaviour, properties and failure mechanisms of engineering materials and components.

• Characterise materials using advanced analytical techniques, including light and electron microscopy (SEM), Energy Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDS), Electron Backscatter Diffraction (EBSD), Focused Ion Beam (FIB), X-ray diffraction (XRD), automated image analysis and instrumented indentation, including nanoindentation and atomic force microscopy (AFM).

• Plan and perform mechanical testing at room and cryogenic temperatures, and help in the development of dedicated test facilities, experimental procedures, and data analysis protocols.

• Lead the execution of failure analyses of materials and components, combining microstructural and mechanical characterisation with non-destructive examination methods, including visual inspection (VT), penetrant testing (PT), ultrasonic testing (UT), radiographic testing (RT) and computed tomography (CT).

• Develop testing strategies and communicate results by defining appropriate test programmes, improving characterisation methodologies and presenting findings to CERN project teams, industrial partners and research institutes.
 Your profile:

• Experience in materials engineering, with a strong background in performing experimental materials characterisation and mechanical testing at cryogenic temperatures.

• Experience working in a multidisciplinary materials laboratory equipped for metallurgical analysis and mechanical testing.
 Would be considered as an asset:

• Experience in advanced mechanical testing in liquid helium (fracture toughness, fatigue), including experimental implementation and evaluation of test results.

• Experience in interpretation of NDT results (RT, PT, CT, UT) applied to assess material soundness.
 Skills:

• Hands-on experience in mechanical testing of structural materials in liquid helium.

• Ability to integrate complementary materials characterisation methods (SEM/EDS, XRD, EBSD) to address complex technical materials challenges.

• Ability to process and interpret experimental data using scientific software and scripting tools.

• Strong organisational skills to coordinate experimental campaigns.

• Clear technical communication and reporting skills.

• Analytical thinking and effective problem-solving abilities.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Materials / Mechanical Engineering (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In qualità di laureato di progetto esperto, contribuirai alla caratterizzazione dei materiali e alle attività di qualificazione a supporto di una vasta gamma di progetti e tecnologie CERN.
Le tue responsabilità includono il supporto, la pianificazione e l'esecuzione di studi su materiali e componenti, coprendo l'approvvigionamento di materiali, la fabbricazione e la qualificazione di montaggio, nonché supervisionando le attività di controllo della qualità per la costruzione di acceleratori di particelle.
Lavorando all'interno del team Materials & Metrology, studierete la microstruttura, la composizione chimica, le proprietà e i meccanismi di guasto dei materiali metallici e altri ingegneri utilizzando le funzionalità avanzate di caratterizzazione della sezione, tra cui la microscopia leggera, la microscopia di Scanning Electron (SEM), la microanalisi, la diffrazione a raggi X (XRD), il test di durezza e l'indentazione strumentata.
Potrai anche eseguire test meccanici a temperature sia ambientali che criogeniche, comprese le valutazioni della resistenza alla frattura, e condurre analisi guasti quando necessario.
Le tue responsabilità:

• Indagare il comportamento, le proprietà e i meccanismi di guasto dei materiali e dei componenti di ingegneria.

• Caratterizzare i materiali utilizzando tecniche analitiche avanzate, tra cui la microscopia della luce e dell'elettrone (SEM), la spettroscopia a raggi X (EDS), la diffrazione di elettroni Backscatter (EBSD), il fascio di ioni focalizzato (FIB), la diffrazione a raggi X (XRD), l'analisi dell'immagine automatizzata e l'indentazione strumentale, tra cui la nanoindentazione e la microscopia atomica della forza (AFM).

• Pianificare e eseguire test meccanici a temperatura ambiente e criogenica, e aiutare nello sviluppo di strutture di prova dedicate, procedure sperimentali e protocolli di analisi dati.

• Guidare l'esecuzione di analisi di guasti di materiali e componenti, combinando la caratterizzazione microstrutturale e meccanica con metodi di esame non distruttivi, tra cui ispezione visiva (VT), test penetranti (PT), test a ultrasuoni (UT), test radiografici (RT) e tomografia computerizzata (CT).

• Sviluppare strategie di test e comunicare i risultati definendo programmi di test appropriati, migliorando metodologie di caratterizzazione e presentando risultati a team di progetto CERN, partner industriali e istituti di ricerca.
Il tuo profilo:

• Esperienza nell'ingegneria dei materiali, con un forte background nell'esecuzione di materiali sperimentali caratterizzazione e test meccanici a temperature criogeniche.

• Esperienza di lavoro in un laboratorio multidisciplinare di materiali attrezzato per analisi metallurgiche e test meccanici.
Sarebbe considerato un bene:

• Esperienza in test meccanici avanzati in elio liquido (tenacità della frattura, affaticamento), tra cui implementazione sperimentale e valutazione dei risultati di prova.

• Esperienza nell'interpretazione dei risultati NDT (RT, PT, CT, UT) applicata per valutare la solidità del materiale.
Competenze:

• Esperienza pratica nella sperimentazione meccanica dei materiali strutturali in elio liquido.

• Capacità di integrare metodi di caratterizzazione dei materiali complementari (SEM/EDS, XRD, EBSD) per affrontare complesse sfide dei materiali tecnici.

• Capacità di elaborare e interpretare i dati sperimentali utilizzando software scientifico e strumenti di scrittura.

• Forte capacità organizzative per coordinare le campagne sperimentali.

• Libera comunicazione tecnica e capacità di reporting.

• Il pensiero analitico e le capacità efficaci di problem solving.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e collaborativo.

• Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese.
Criteri di ammissibilità:

• Sei un cittadino di uno Stato membro del CERN o di uno Stato membro associato .

• Hai uno sfondo professionale in Materiali / Ingegneria meccanica (o un campo correlato) e hanno o:
• un Master con 2 a 6 anni di esperienza professionale post-graduazione;

• o un dottorato con non più di 3 anni di esperienza professionale post-graduazione.

• Non hai mai avuto un contratto di laurea o di socio del CERN.

descriptionByLocale.en:
As an Experienced Project Graduate, you will contribute to materials characterisation and qualification activities supporting a wide range of CERN projects and technologies.
Your responsibilities will include supporting, planning and executing studies on materials and components, covering materials procurement, fabrication and assembly qualification, as well as overseeing quality control activities for the construction of particle accelerators.
Working within the Materials & Metrology team, you will investigate the microstructure, chemical composition, properties and failure mechanisms of metallic and other engineering materials using the section's advanced characterisation capabilities, including light microscopy, Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM), microanalysis, X-ray diffraction (XRD), hardness testing and instrumented indentation.
You will also perform mechanical testing at both ambient and cryogenic temperatures, including fracture toughness assessments, and conduct failure analyses when required.
Your responsibilities:

• Investigate the behaviour, properties and failure mechanisms of engineering materials and components.

• Characterise materials using advanced analytical techniques, including light and electron microscopy (SEM), Energy Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDS), Electron Backscatter Diffraction (EBSD), Focused Ion Beam (FIB), X-ray diffraction (XRD), automated image analysis and instrumented indentation, including nanoindentation and atomic force microscopy (AFM).

• Plan and perform mechanical testing at room and cryogenic temperatures, and help in the development of dedicated test facilities, experimental procedures, and data analysis protocols.

• Lead the execution of failure analyses of materials and components, combining microstructural and mechanical characterisation with non-destructive examination methods, including visual inspection (VT), penetrant testing (PT), ultrasonic testing (UT), radiographic testing (RT) and computed tomography (CT).

• Develop testing strategies and communicate results by defining appropriate test programmes, improving characterisation methodologies and presenting findings to CERN project teams, industrial partners and research institutes.
Your profile:

• Experience in materials engineering, with a strong background in performing experimental materials characterisation and mechanical testing at cryogenic temperatures.

• Experience working in a multidisciplinary materials laboratory equipped for metallurgical analysis and mechanical testing.
Would be considered as an asset:

• Experience in advanced mechanical testing in liquid helium (fracture toughness, fatigue), including experimental implementation and evaluation of test results.

• Experience in interpretation of NDT results (RT, PT, CT, UT) applied to assess material soundness.
Skills:

• Hands-on experience in mechanical testing of structural materials in liquid helium.

• Ability to integrate complementary materials characterisation methods (SEM/EDS, XRD, EBSD) to address complex technical materials challenges.

• Ability to process and interpret experimental data using scientific software and scripting tools.

• Strong organisational skills to coordinate experimental campaigns.

• Clear technical communication and reporting skills.

• Analytical thinking and effective problem-solving abilities.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Materials / Mechanical Engineering (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Als erfahrener Projektabsolvent tragen Sie zu Materialcharakterisierungs- und Qualifizierungsaktivitäten bei, die eine breite Palette von CERN-Projekten und -Technologien unterstützen.
Ihre Aufgaben umfassen die Unterstützung, Planung und Durchführung von Studien zu Materialien und Komponenten, die Materialbeschaffung, Fertigung und Montagequalifikation sowie die Überwachung von Qualitätskontrollaktivitäten für den Bau von Partikelbeschleunigern.
In Zusammenarbeit mit dem Materials & Metrology-Team untersuchen Sie die Mikrostruktur, die chemische Zusammensetzung, die Eigenschaften und die Versagensmechanismen von metallischen und anderen technischen Materialien unter Verwendung der erweiterten Charakterisierungsfähigkeiten des Abschnitts, einschließlich Lichtmikroskopie, Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM), Mikroanalyse, Röntgenbeugung (XRD), Härteprüfung und instrumentierte Einbuchtung.
Sie führen auch mechanische Tests sowohl bei Umgebungs- als auch bei kryogenen Temperaturen durch, einschließlich der Beurteilung der Bruchfestigkeit, und führen bei Bedarf Fehleranalysen durch.
Ihre Aufgaben:

• Untersuchen Sie das Verhalten, die Eigenschaften und die Fehlermechanismen von technischen Materialien und Komponenten.

• Charakterisierung von Materialien unter Verwendung fortschrittlicher Analysetechniken, einschließlich Licht- und Elektronenmikroskopie (SEM), Energiedispersive Röntgenspektroskopie (EDS), Elektronenrückstreuungsbeugung (EBSD), fokussierter Ionenstrahl (FIB), Röntgenbeugung (XRD), automatisierte Bildanalyse und instrumentierte Einrückung, einschließlich Nanoindentation und Rasterkraftmikroskopie (AFM).

• Planen und führen Sie mechanische Tests bei Raum- und Kryotemperaturen durch und helfen Sie bei der Entwicklung spezieller Testeinrichtungen, experimenteller Verfahren und Datenanalyseprotokolle.

• Führen Sie die Durchführung von Fehleranalysen von Materialien und Komponenten durch die Kombination von mikrostruktureller und mechanischer Charakterisierung mit zerstörungsfreien Untersuchungsmethoden, einschließlich Sichtprüfung (VT), Penetrantenprüfung (PT), Ultraschallprüfung (UT), Röntgenprüfung (RT) und Computertomographie (CT).

• Entwicklung von Teststrategien und Vermittlung von Ergebnissen durch Definition geeigneter Testprogramme, Verbesserung der Charakterisierungsmethoden und Präsentation der Ergebnisse für CERN-Projektteams, Industriepartner und Forschungsinstitute.
Ihr Profil:

• Erfahrung in der Materialtechnik, mit einem starken Hintergrund in der Durchführung experimenteller Materialcharakterisierung und mechanischer Tests bei kryogenen Temperaturen.

• Erfahrung in einem multidisziplinären Materiallabor, das für metallurgische Analysen und mechanische Prüfungen ausgestattet ist.
Würde als Vermögenswert betrachtet werden:

• Erfahrung in der fortgeschrittenen mechanischen Prüfung von flüssigem Helium (Frakturzähigkeit, Ermüdung), einschließlich der experimentellen Umsetzung und Bewertung der Testergebnisse.

• Erfahrung in der Interpretation von zerstörungsfreien Prüfverfahren (RT, PT, CT, UT), die zur Beurteilung der Materialfestigkeit angewandt wurde.
Fähigkeiten:

• Hands-on Erfahrung in der mechanischen Prüfung von Strukturmaterialien in flüssigem Helium.

• Fähigkeit zur Integration komplementärer Materialcharakterisierungsmethoden (SEM/EDS, XRD, EBSD) zur Bewältigung komplexer technischer Materialherausforderungen.

• Fähigkeit, experimentelle Daten mit wissenschaftlicher Software und Skripting-Tools zu verarbeiten und zu interpretieren.

• Klare technische Kommunikations- und Berichtsfähigkeiten.

• Analytisches Denken und effektive Problemlösungsfähigkeiten.

En tant que diplômé de projet expérimenté, vous contribuerez à des activités de caractérisation des matériaux et de qualification soutenant un large éventail de projets et de technologies du CERN.
Vos responsabilités comprendront le soutien, la planification et l'exécution d'études sur les matériaux et les composants, portant sur l'acquisition des matériaux, la fabrication et la qualification de montage, ainsi que la supervision des activités de contrôle de la qualité pour la construction d'accélérateurs de particules.
En travaillant au sein de l'équipe Matériaux et Métrologie, vous étudierez la microstructure, la composition chimique, les propriétés et les mécanismes de défaillance des matériaux métalliques et autres matériaux d'ingénierie en utilisant les capacités de caractérisation avancées de la section, y compris la microscopie légère, la microscopie électronique à balayage (SEM), la microanalyse, la diffraction des rayons X (XRD), les tests de dureté et l'indentation instrumentée.
Vous effectuerez également des essais mécaniques aux températures ambiantes et cryogéniques, y compris des évaluations de la résistance à la rupture, et effectuerez des analyses de défaillance au besoin.
Vos responsabilités :

• Étudier le comportement, les propriétés et les mécanismes de défaillance des matériaux et composants d'ingénierie.

• Caractériser les matériaux à l'aide de techniques d'analyse avancées, y compris la microscopie à lumière et à électrons (SEM), la spectroscopie à rayons X à dispersion d'énergie (EDS), la diffraction par rétrodiffusion d'électrons (EBSD), la faisceaux d'ions focalisés (FIB), la diffraction par rayons X (XRD), l'analyse automatisée des images et l'indentation instrumentale, y compris la nano-identification et la microscopie à force atomique (AFM).

• Planifier et effectuer des essais mécaniques aux températures ambiantes et cryogéniques, et aider à la mise au point d'installations d'essai, de procédures expérimentales et de protocoles d'analyse des données.

• Diriger l'exécution d'analyses de défaillance de matériaux et de composants, combinant la caractérisation microstructurale et mécanique avec des méthodes d'examen non destructive, y compris l'inspection visuelle (VT), les essais de pénétration (PT), les essais à ultrasons (UT), les essais radiographiques (RT) et la tomographie calculée (CT).

• Élaborer des stratégies d'essai et communiquer les résultats en définissant des programmes d'essai appropriés, en améliorant les méthodes de caractérisation et en présentant les résultats aux équipes de projet du CERN, aux partenaires industriels et aux instituts de recherche.
Votre profil:

• Expérience en ingénierie des matériaux, avec une solide expérience dans la caractérisation expérimentale des matériaux et les essais mécaniques à des températures cryogéniques.

• Expérience dans un laboratoire multidisciplinaire de matériaux équipé pour l'analyse métallurgique et les essais mécaniques.
Serait considéré comme un actif :

• Expérience en essais mécaniques avancés dans l'hélium liquide (résistance à la fracture, fatigue), y compris mise en œuvre expérimentale et évaluation des résultats d'essais.

• Expérience dans l'interprétation des résultats de NDT (RT, PT, CT, UT) appliqués pour évaluer la solidité matérielle.
Compétences :

• Expérience pratique dans les essais mécaniques de matériaux structuraux en hélium liquide.

• Capacité d'intégrer des méthodes complémentaires de caractérisation des matériaux (SEM/EDS, XRD, EBSD) pour relever des défis techniques complexes.

• Capacité de traiter et d'interpréter des données expérimentales à l'aide de logiciels scientifiques et d'outils de script.

• Des compétences organisationnelles solides pour coordonner les campagnes expérimentales.

• Compétences claires en matière de communication technique et de rapport.

• Pensée analytique et capacités efficaces de résolution de problèmes.

• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et en collaboration.

• Anglais parlé et écrit, avec un engagement à apprendre le français.

jobs.description:
We are offering a position in the Physics Software Engineering section of the Computing for Experiments group in the CERN IT department (IT-CE-PSE) on Performance Software Engineering in the realm of high energy physics data simulation.
 The work on this post will be carried out in the context of the NextGen project, a collaboration between the LHC experiments and the CERN Research and Computing Departments. NextGen explores the use and impact of high-performance computing architectures in data simulation and data processing for the LHC experiments with a focus on the upcoming High Luminosity (HL-LHC) data taking phase at the CERN Large Hadron Collider.
 The simulation of particle collisions is one of the main consumers of computing resources for LHC experiments. Given the expected increase in the required statistics, accuracy and complexity for future simulation, and to stay within the forecasted computing budget, the throughput of simulation software packages needs to increase substantially.
 The successful candidate will join a team of software engineers and physicists that addresses this challenge. Together, you will speed up software packages for Monte Carlo (MC) event generation with a focus on the Madgraph event generator suite. Current and future tasks tackled by the team are at the intersection of theoretical/computational physics and computer science. In order to profit from the latest computing hardware, adaptations or re-engineering of software in aspects such as data structures, parallelisation of the workflow or task scheduling are needed. This work is guided by the requirements of experimental analyses and takes into account the latest developments in theoretical predictions.
 In case of interest, training on data science, programming languages, software engineering concepts and computing architectures is available and can be provided via various training programs.
 Your responsibilities:

• Analyse and profile existing simulation code bases and develop strategies for improving their throughput.

• Implement latest software engineering concepts, leveraging on compute accelerators such as GPUs, modern CPU architectures and heterogeneous compute platforms.

• Interact and collaborate with experts in the theory, experimental physics and software engineering communities at CERN and world-wide.

• Supervise students on software development tasks and projects.
 Your profile:

• Preferably a PhD in Theoretical or Particle Physics or Master's Degree with equivalent work experience with a strong background in numerical simulation.

• Proficiency in working with computing hardware accelerators and modern computing architectures, including heterogeneous compute platforms.

• A proven track record in performance software engineering for simulation applications in C++ and GPU programming languages such as CUDA or HIP.

• Knowledge of state of the art profiling tools for heterogeneous computing architectures.

• Experience with the Madgraph event generator software as a developer or user is highly valued.

• Proficiency in modern C++ (up to C++23), GPU programming with CUDA and HIP, and Python for scripting, analysis and tooling is essential.

• Knowledge of hard scattering processes and the perturbative order of their matrix element calculations in Monte Carlo event generators is strongly desirable.

• Familiarity with Fortran is an advantage.

• Fluent in English.

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the basics of the other language.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You have a professional background in Theoretical or Particle Physics (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's Degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

descriptionByLocale.it:
Stiamo offrendo una posizione nella sezione Ingegneria del Software di Fisica del gruppo Computing for Experiments nel dipartimento IT CERN (IT-CE-PSE) su Performance Software Engineering nel regno della simulazione di dati di fisica ad alta energia.
Il lavoro su questo post sarà svolto nel contesto del progetto NextGen, una collaborazione tra gli esperimenti LHC e i Dipartimenti di Ricerca e Computing del CERN. NextGen esplora l'uso e l'impatto di architetture di calcolo ad alte prestazioni nella simulazione dei dati e nell'elaborazione dei dati per gli esperimenti LHC con un focus sui prossimi dati High Luminosity (HL-LHC) che prendono fase al CERN Large Hadron Collider.
La simulazione di collisioni di particelle è uno dei principali consumatori di risorse di calcolo per gli esperimenti LHC. Data l'aumento previsto delle statistiche richieste, l'accuratezza e la complessità per la simulazione futura, e per rimanere all'interno del bilancio di calcolo previsto, il throughput dei pacchetti software di simulazione deve aumentare notevolmente.
Il candidato di successo si unirà a un team di ingegneri e fisici software che affronta questa sfida. Insieme, velocizzerai i pacchetti software per la generazione di eventi Monte Carlo (MC) con un focus sulla suite generatore di eventi Madgraph. I compiti attuali e futuri affrontati dal team sono all'incrocio tra fisica teorica / computazionale e scienza informatica. Al fine di trarre profitto dall'hardware di calcolo più recente, sono necessari adattamenti o riingegneria del software in aspetti come le strutture di dati, la parallelizzazione del flusso di lavoro o la pianificazione delle attività. Questo lavoro è guidato dai requisiti delle analisi sperimentali e tiene conto degli ultimi sviluppi delle previsioni teoriche.
In caso di interesse, la formazione sulla scienza dei dati, linguaggi di programmazione, concetti di ingegneria del software e architetture di calcolo è disponibile e può essere fornito tramite vari programmi di formazione.
Le tue responsabilità:

• Analizzare e profilare le basi di codice di simulazione esistenti e sviluppare strategie per migliorare il loro throughput.

• Implementare i più recenti concetti di ingegneria del software, sfruttando gli acceleratori di calcolo come GPU, moderne architetture della CPU e piattaforme di calcolo eterogenee.

• Interagire e collaborare con esperti nelle comunità di teoria, fisica sperimentale e ingegneria software del CERN e mondiale.

descriptionByLocale.en:
We are offering a position in the Physics Software Engineering section of the Computing for Experiments group in the CERN IT department (IT-CE-PSE) on Performance Software Engineering in the realm of high energy physics data simulation.
The work on this post will be carried out in the context of the NextGen project, a collaboration between the LHC experiments and the CERN Research and Computing Departments. NextGen explores the use and impact of high-performance computing architectures in data simulation and data processing for the LHC experiments with a focus on the upcoming High Luminosity (HL-LHC) data taking phase at the CERN Large Hadron Collider.
The simulation of particle collisions is one of the main consumers of computing resources for LHC experiments. Given the expected increase in the required statistics, accuracy and complexity for future simulation, and to stay within the forecasted computing budget, the throughput of simulation software packages needs to increase substantially.
The successful candidate will join a team of software engineers and physicists that addresses this challenge. Together, you will speed up software packages for Monte Carlo (MC) event generation with a focus on the Madgraph event generator suite. Current and future tasks tackled by the team are at the intersection of theoretical/computational physics and computer science. In order to profit from the latest computing hardware, adaptations or re-engineering of software in aspects such as data structures, parallelisation of the workflow or task scheduling are needed. This work is guided by the requirements of experimental analyses and takes into account the latest developments in theoretical predictions.
In case of interest, training on data science, programming languages, software engineering concepts and computing architectures is available and can be provided via various training programs.
Your responsibilities:

• Analyse and profile existing simulation code bases and develop strategies for improving their throughput.

• Implement latest software engineering concepts, leveraging on compute accelerators such as GPUs, modern CPU architectures and heterogeneous compute platforms.

• Interact and collaborate with experts in the theory, experimental physics and software engineering communities at CERN and world-wide.

• Supervise students on software development tasks and projects.
Your profile:

• Preferably a PhD in Theoretical or Particle Physics or Master's Degree with equivalent work experience with a strong background in numerical simulation.

• Proficiency in working with computing hardware accelerators and modern computing architectures, including heterogeneous compute platforms.

• A proven track record in performance software engineering for simulation applications in C++ and GPU programming languages such as CUDA or HIP.

• Knowledge of state of the art profiling tools for heterogeneous computing architectures.

• Experience with the Madgraph event generator software as a developer or user is highly valued.
Skills:

• Proficiency in modern C++ (up to C++23), GPU programming with CUDA and HIP, and Python for scripting, analysis and tooling is essential.

• Knowledge of hard scattering processes and the perturbative order of their matrix element calculations in Monte Carlo event generators is strongly desirable.

• Familiarity with Fortran is an advantage.

• Fluent in English.

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the basics of the other language.
Eligibility criteria:

• You have a professional background in Theoretical or Particle Physics (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's Degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Hybrid
Target start date: 01-January-2027
This position involves:

• Stand-by duty, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
Job reference: IT-CE-PSE-2026-167-GRAP
Field of work: Information Technologies
Benchmark job: 200020 - Computing Engineer

Global Benefits

• A monthly net stipend of either 6372 or 7004 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.

Die Arbeit an diesem Beitrag wird im Rahmen des NextGen-Projekts durchgeführt, einer Zusammenarbeit zwischen den LHC-Experimenten und den CERN-Forschungs- und Computerabteilungen. NextGen untersucht den Einsatz und die Auswirkungen von Hochleistungs-Computing-Architekturen in der Datensimulation und Datenverarbeitung für die LHC-Experimente mit Schwerpunkt auf der bevorstehenden High Luminosity (HL-LHC)-Datenphase am CERN Large Hadron Collider.
Die Simulation von Teilchenkollisionen ist einer der Hauptverbraucher von Rechenressourcen für LHC-Experimente. Angesichts der erwarteten Zunahme der erforderlichen Statistiken, Genauigkeit und Komplexität für zukünftige Simulationen und um innerhalb des prognostizierten Rechenbudgets zu bleiben, muss der Durchsatz von Simulationssoftwarepaketen erheblich erhöht werden.

Le travail sur ce poste sera réalisé dans le cadre du projet NextGen, une collaboration entre les expériences LHC et les départements de recherche et de calcul du CERN. NextGen explore l'utilisation et l'impact des architectures informatiques de haute performance dans la simulation et le traitement des données pour les expériences LHC en mettant l'accent sur la prochaine phase de prise de données High Luminosity (HL-LHC) au CERN Large Hadron Collider.
La simulation des collisions de particules est l'un des principaux consommateurs de ressources informatiques pour les expériences de LHC. Compte tenu de l'augmentation prévue des statistiques, de l'exactitude et de la complexité des simulations futures, et pour rester dans les limites prévues du budget informatique, le débit des progiciels de simulation doit augmenter considérablement.

Les tâches actuelles et futures de l'équipe sont à l'intersection de la physique théorique/computationnelle et de l'informatique. Introduzione:
Unisciti al Gruppo Gestione delle informazioni (IM ) all’interno del Dipartimento Ingegneria (EN) per implementare e supportare le soluzioni CAD e Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) mission-critical per la comunità ingegneristica dell’Organizzazione. Sarete parte del team che consente la trasformazione di ingegneria digitale del CERN, dove la vostra esperienza, esperienza e capacità di imparare sarà fondamentale.
Funzioni:

• Fornire assistenza tecnica avanzata per il portafoglio di applicazioni CAD e PLM del CERN.

• Pianificare ed eseguire test di sistema e validazione delle prestazioni per un ampio portafoglio di applicazioni ingegneristiche.

• Servire come punto di contatto per le comunità degli utenti, traducendo le esigenze specializzate in soluzioni tecniche.

• Mentor e coach junior membri del team, promuovendo lo sviluppo di competenze tecniche e l'adozione di ingegneria digitale.

• Eseguire l'analisi di business ai requisiti di ingegneria del ponte e alla consegna tecnica, supportando l'implementazione di flussi di lavoro innovativi, compresi gli standard di visualizzazione e le integrazioni di sistema.

• Laurea o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo dell'ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria dei sistemi, o campo tecnico equivalente o un campo relativo.
Esperienza:

• Competenze pratiche con ecosistemi di progettazione 3D su larga scala (ad esempio CATIA, Siemens NX, Creo, Revit).

• Competenza negli standard di scambio del prodotto/CAD e esperienza con flussi di lavoro di conversione del modello 3D automatizzati.

• Prove capacità di analisi aziendale che coprono la valutazione dei problemi, l'ingegneria dei requisiti e l'ottimizzazione dei processi.

• Forte capacità di allineare le parti interessate a livello aziendale e risolvere complesse sfide tecniche.

• Demonstrated track record nel fornire supporto tecnico e coaching all'interno di un ambiente di ingegneria collaborativa.
Competenze tecniche:

• Configurazione e utilizzo dei sistemi di gestione delle informazioni.

• Conoscenza e applicazione di strumenti e procedure del ciclo di vita del software.

• Test, diagnosi e ottimizzazione del software.
Competenze comportamentali:

• Risultati ottenuti: definizione di obiettivi chiari, pietre miliari e realizzabili prima di avviare il lavoro/progetto.

• Building Relationships: mostrare un sincero interesse per le preoccupazioni e le prospettive degli altri.

• Comunicare efficacemente: esprimere opinioni, idee e suggerimenti con convinzione e in modo logico/strutturato; mantenere al punto.

• Dimostrare la responsabilità: assumersi la responsabilità delle proprie azioni e decisioni.
Capacità linguistiche:

• Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese.

Ammissibilità e chiusura:
La diversità è parte integrante della missione del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione ed è un valore consolidato dell'Organizzazione. Sfruttare una forza lavoro diversificata è fondamentale per il nostro successo. Accogliamo con favore le domande di tutti gli Stati membri e degli Stati membri associati.
Questa vacanza sarà riempita il più presto possibile, e le applicazioni dovrebbero normalmente raggiungerci non oltre 13.12.2026 a 23:50 CET.
Condizioni di lavoro:
Tipo di contratto: contratto di durata limitata (5 anni). Fatto salvo determinate condizioni, i titolari di contratti a durata limitata possono richiedere una posizione a tempo indeterminato.
Orario di lavoro: 40 ore a settimana
Flessibilità del lavoro: ibrido
Questa posizione comporta:

• Una patente di guida valida.

• Lavorare durante le notti, la domenica e le vacanze ufficiali, quando richiesto dalle esigenze dell'Organizzazione.
Grado di lavoro: 4-5
Riferimento del lavoro: EN-IM-CEP-2026-224-LD
Campo di lavoro: Ingegneria meccanica
Benchmark Titolo del lavoro: Computing Technical Engineer

Vantaggi globali

• Uno stipendio competitivo (gratuito fiscale), in linea con gli anni di esperienza rilevante.

• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.

• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.

• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.

• Un pacchetto di trasferimento (concessione di installazione, rimozione, spese di viaggio) a seconda delle vostre circostanze individuali.

• Possibilità di estendere il contratto fino a 8 anni + ammissibilità per un periodo di tempo indeterminato.
Panoramica del CERN - Scopri un mondo in cui l'impossibile è reso possibile!
Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano.
Ogni giorno affrontiamo nuove entusiasmanti sfide e opportunità per contribuire alla ricerca all'avanguardia che plasma la nostra comprensione dell'universo. Incontriamo queste sfide attraverso le diverse prospettive all'interno dei nostri team, assicurando che ogni contributo sia valutato e guida il nostro senso condiviso di inclusione e scopo. La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione, e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e il successo continuo.
Se siete pronti a far parte di una comunità dinamica e inclusiva che spinge i confini della conoscenza, il CERN è il luogo in cui la vostra curiosità e abilità possono prosperare. Fate parte della nostra missione per scoprire cosa sta nel cuore dell'universo! Partecipa!
Maggiori informazioni su di noi, qui: careers.cern
descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction:
Join the Information Management (IM ) Group within the Engineering (EN) Department to implement and support mission-critical CAD and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) solutions for the Organization’s engineering community. You will be part of the team enabling CERN’s digital engineering transformation, where your expertise, experience, and ability to learn will be key.
Functions:

• Provide advanced technical assistance for CERN’s portfolio of CAD and PLM applications.

• Plan and execute system testing and performance validation for a broad portfolio of engineering applications.

• Serve as a point of contact for user communities, translating specialised needs into technical solutions.

• Mentor and coach junior members of the team, fostering technical skill development and digital engineering adoption.

• Perform business analysis to bridge engineering requirements and technical delivery, supporting the implementation of innovative workflows, including visualisation standards and system integrations.

• Bachelor's Degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or equivalent technical field or a related field.
Experience:

• Hands-on expertise with large-scale 3D design ecosystems (e.g. CATIA, Siemens NX, Creo, Revit).

• Expertise in Product/CAD exchange standards and experience with automated 3D model conversion workflows.

• Proven business analysis skills covering problem assessment, requirements engineering, and process optimisation.

• Strong ability to align enterprise-wide stakeholders and resolve complex technical challenges.

• Demonstrated track record in delivering technical support and coaching within a collaborative engineering environment.
Technical competencies:

• Configuration and use of information management systems.

• Knowledge and application of software life-cycle tools and procedures.

• Testing, diagnosing and optimisation of software.
Behavioural competencies:

• Achieving Results: defining clear objectives, milestones and deliverables before initiating work/ project.

• Building Relationships: showing a sincere interest in the concerns and perspectives of others.

• Communicating Effectively: expressing opinions, ideas and suggestions with conviction and in a logical/structured manner; keeping to the point.

• Demonstrating Accountability: taking responsibility for own actions and decisions.
Language skills:

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 13.12.2026 at 23:50 CET.
Employment Conditions:
Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Job Flexibility: Hybrid
This position involves:

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
Job grade: 4-5
Job reference: EN-IM-CEP-2026-224-LD
Field of work: Mechanical Engineering
Benchmark Job Title: Computing Technical Engineer

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! TAKE PART!
More information about us, here: careers.cern
descriptionByLocale.de:
Einleitung:
Treten Sie der Information Management (IM)-Gruppe innerhalb der Engineering (EN)-Abteilung bei, um unternehmenskritische CAD- und Product Lifecycle Management (PLM)-Lösungen für die Engineering-Community des Unternehmens zu implementieren und zu unterstützen. Sie werden Teil des Teams sein, das die digitale Engineering-Transformation des CERN ermöglicht, bei der Ihr Fachwissen, Ihre Erfahrung und Ihre Lernfähigkeit von entscheidender Bedeutung sind.
Funktionen:

• Bereitstellung fortschrittlicher technischer Unterstützung für das CERN-Portfolio von CAD- und PLM-Anwendungen.

• Planen und Ausführen von Systemtests und Leistungsvalidierung für ein breites Portfolio von Engineering-Anwendungen.

• Dienen Sie als Anlaufstelle für Benutzergemeinschaften und übersetzen Sie spezielle Bedürfnisse in technische Lösungen.

• Mentor und Coach Juniormitglieder des Teams, die Entwicklung technischer Fähigkeiten und die Einführung von Digital Engineering fördern.

• Führen Sie Geschäftsanalysen durch, um Engineering-Anforderungen und technische Lieferungen zu überbrücken und die Implementierung innovativer Workflows zu unterstützen, einschließlich Visualisierungsstandards und Systemintegrationen.

• Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige einschlägige Erfahrung im Bereich Maschinenbau, Systems Engineering oder gleichwertigen technischen Bereich oder einem verwandten Bereich.
Erfahrung:

• Hands-on-Expertise mit groß angelegten 3D-Design-Ökosystemen (z. B. CATIA, Siemens NX, Creo, Revit).

• Expertise im Produkt-/CAD-Austausch von Standards und Erfahrung mit automatisierten 3D-Modell-Konvertierungs-Workflows.

• Bewährte Business-Analyse-Fähigkeiten, die Problembewertung, Requirements Engineering und Prozessoptimierung umfassen.

• Starke Fähigkeit, unternehmensweite Stakeholder zusammenzubringen und komplexe technische Herausforderungen zu lösen.

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Bereitstellung von technischem Support und Coaching in einer kollaborativen Engineering-Umgebung.
Technische Kompetenzen:

• Konfiguration und Nutzung von Informationsmanagementsystemen.

• Kenntnisse und Anwendung von Software-Lebenszyklus-Tools und -Verfahren.

• Test, Diagnose und Optimierung von Software.
Verhaltenskompetenzen:

• Erreichen von Ergebnissen: Definition klarer Ziele, Meilensteine und Ergebnisse vor Beginn der Arbeit / des Projekts.

• Aufbau von Beziehungen: ein aufrichtiges Interesse an den Anliegen und Perspektiven anderer zeigen.

• Effektiv kommunizieren: Meinungen, Ideen und Vorschläge mit Überzeugung und in einer logischen / strukturierten Weise ausdrücken; auf den Punkt bringen.

• Nachweis der Rechenschaftspflicht: Übernahme von Verantwortung für eigene Handlungen und Entscheidungen.
Sprachkenntnisse:

• Englisch gesprochen und geschrieben, mit der Verpflichtung, Französisch zu lernen.

Förderfähigkeit und Stichtag:
Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein integraler Bestandteil der Mission des CERN und ist ein fester Wert der Organisation. Die Beschäftigung einer vielfältigen Belegschaft ist zentral für unseren Erfolg. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen aus allen Mitgliedstaaten und assoziierten Mitgliedstaaten.
Diese freie Stelle wird so schnell wie möglich besetzt und die Bewerbungen sollten uns normalerweise bis spätestens 13.12.2026 um 23:50 Uhr MEZ erreichen.
Beschäftigungsbedingungen:
Vertragsart: Befristeter Vertrag (5 Jahre). Unter bestimmten Bedingungen können Inhaber von befristeten Verträgen eine unbefristete Position beantragen.
Arbeitszeit: 40 Stunden pro Woche
Arbeitsplatzflexibilität: Hybrid
Diese Position umfasst:

• Ein gültiger Führerschein.

• Arbeiten in den Nächten, Sonntagen und offiziellen Feiertagen, wenn es die Bedürfnisse der Organisation erfordern.
Job Grade: 4-5
Arbeitsnummer: EN-IM-CEP-2026-224-LD
Arbeitsgebiet: Maschinenbau
Benchmark Job Title: Computertechniker

Globale Vorteile

• Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt (steuerfrei), das im Einklang mit Ihrer jahrelangen relevanten Erfahrung steigt.

• 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr plus 2 Wochen jährliche Schließung.

• Deckung durch die umfassende Krankenversicherung des CERN (für Sie, Ihren Ehepartner und Ihre Kinder) und die Mitgliedschaft in der CERN-Pensionskasse.

• Familien-, Kinder- und Säuglingszulagen, abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

• Ein Umzugspaket (Installationszuschuss, Umzug, Reisekosten) abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

• Möglichkeit, Ihren Vertrag bis zu 8 Jahre zu verlängern + Anspruch auf unbefristete Vertragsdauer.
Überblick über CERN - Entdecken Sie eine Welt, in der das Unmögliche möglich gemacht wird!
Bei CERN, der Europäischen Organisation für Kernforschung, erweitern wir die Grenzen von Wissenschaft und Technologie. Unsere bahnbrechende Arbeit bringt nicht nur Physiker zusammen, sondern auch eine Vielzahl von Fachleuten aus den Bereichen Ingenieurwesen, Technik, Wissenschaft und Verwaltung. Gemeinsam fördern wir ein Umfeld, in dem Innovation und Zusammenarbeit gedeihen.
Jeden Tag stehen wir vor spannenden neuen Herausforderungen und Möglichkeiten, einen Beitrag zur Spitzenforschung zu leisten, die unser Verständnis des Universums prägt. Wir begegnen diesen Herausforderungen durch die vielfältigen Perspektiven in unseren Teams, stellen sicher, dass jeder Beitrag wertgeschätzt wird und fördern unser gemeinsames Gefühl von Inklusion und Zweck. Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein zentraler Wert des CERN und bleibt für unsere Mission und unseren anhaltenden Erfolg von zentraler Bedeutung.
Wenn Sie bereit sind, Teil einer dynamischen, integrativen Gemeinschaft zu sein, die die Grenzen des Wissens überschreitet, ist CERN der Ort, an dem Ihre Neugier und Ihre Fähigkeiten gedeihen können. Seien Sie Teil unserer Mission, das aufzudecken, was im Herzen des Universums liegt! TEIL!

• Expérience démontrée en matière de soutien technique et d'encadrement dans un environnement d'ingénierie collaborative.

• Configuration et utilisation des systèmes de gestion de l'information.

jobs.title: Big Data Software Engineer (BE-CSS-IDE-2026-176-GRAP)
jobs.description:
Join the BE-CSS-IDE section and help shape how CERN stores and serves data from the High-Luminosity Large Hadron Collider (HL-LHC).
 NXCALS, the CERN accelerator archival system, holds many years of data from CERN's particle accelerators: magnet and powering signals, beam instrumentation, cryogenics, and machine protection and post-mortem data. Accelerator operators, equipment experts and beam physicists use it every day to run the machine, diagnose faults and study performance.
 Your work will focus on the needs of the HL-LHC. You will help keep NXCALS fast, reliable and scalable as particle accelerator data volumes grow and the machine moves toward the High-Luminosity LHC era. You will work on a real production system alongside experienced engineers, with plenty of opportunities to learn and take ownership.
 Your responsibilities:

• Contribute to the development of NXCALS core components, focusing on HL-LHC use cases: ingestion pipelines (ETL), metadata services, data compaction, data extraction and APIs.

• Improve the performance and reliability of data access for LHC operations, machine protection analyses and commissioning activities.

• Work with accelerator users in the CERN Control Centre and equipment groups to understand their needs and help them build applications and analyses on NXCALS.

• Help evaluate big-data technologies (such as HDFS, Apache Ozone or ClickHouse) and their fit for future HL-LHC data requirements.

• Follow modern engineering practices in a team that values code quality, testing and automation.
 Your profile:

• Solid experience in Java development; familiarity with the Spring ecosystem is an advantage.

• Experience with, or strong interest in, big-data technologies such as Hadoop, HDFS, HBase, ClickHouse, Apache Spark or Kafka.

• Working knowledge of Python; experience with PySpark is a plus.

• Familiarity with software quality practices, CI/CD and DevOps.

• Curiosity about particle accelerators and enthusiasm for working with diverse user communities.
 Skills:

• Java.

• Spring ecosystem (advantage).

• Hadoop, HDFS, HBase, ClickHouse.

• Apache Spark, Kafka.

• Python, PySpark (plus).

• Software quality practices.

• CI/CD, DevOps.

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the basics of the other language.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Software Engineering (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 06.12.2026 at 23:59 CET.
 Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
 Working hours: 40 hours per week
 Job flexibility: Hybrid
 Target start date: 01-March-2027
 Job reference: BE-CSS-IDE-2026-176-GRAP
 Field of work: Information Technologies
 Benchmark job: 200020 - Computing Engineer

Global Benefits

• A monthly net stipend of either 6372 or 7004 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
 Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
 Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti alla sezione BE-CSS-IDE e aiuta a modellare come il CERN memorizza e serve i dati dall'High-Luminosity Large Hadron Collider (HL-LHC).
NXCALS, il sistema di archiviazione dell'acceleratore CERN, detiene molti anni di dati dagli acceleratori di particelle del CERN: segnali magnetici e di alimentazione, strumentazione del fascio, criogenici, protezione della macchina e dati post-mortem. Are you a technician looking for an opportunity to contribute to the Future Circular Collider (FCC), one of the most ambitious scientific projects ever envisioned? Help develop the coating technology that will equip its vacuum chambers with a Non-Evaporable Getter thin film.
Working alongside experienced engineers, technicians and physicists, you will contribute to the design, fabrication and coating.
You will be involved at every stage of the process. We will provide all the necessary training and support, making this an excellent opportunity to develop specialist skills in a unique international environment.
Your responsibilities:

• Design & construction of mechanical parts for customised physical vapor deposition systems and associated tooling.

• Assembly of coating setups operating in Ultra High Vacuum.

• Validation of the coating technology and process (in real scale prototypes up to 12 meter long beam pipes).

• Validation of the vacuum performance of the coatings produced (in Ultra High Vacuum systems).
Your profile:

• Experience in machining metal parts in lathe and milling machines. CNC would be an advantage.

• Familiarity in using CAD software to design mechanical parts.

• Practical experience in assembling mechanical equipment.

• Experience in vacuum technology would be an advantage.
Skills:

• Working in teams.

• Curious and proactive.

• Knowledge of vacuum technology would be an advantage.

• Knowledge on welding would be an advantage.

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the basics of the other language.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Mechanical Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is a general secondary education diploma .

• Applicants with a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree are not eligible.

Sind Sie ein Techniker, der nach einer Gelegenheit sucht, zum Future Circular Collider (FCC) beizutragen, einem der ehrgeizigsten wissenschaftlichen Projekte, die jemals geplant wurden? Helfen Sie bei der Entwicklung der Beschichtungstechnologie, die ihre Vakuumkammern mit einem nicht verdampfbaren Getter-Dünnfilm ausstattet.
In Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Ingenieuren, Technikern und Physikern tragen Sie zum Design, zur Herstellung und Beschichtung bei.
Sie werden in jeder Phase des Prozesses beteiligt sein. Wir werden alle notwendigen Schulungen und Unterstützung anbieten, was dies zu einer hervorragenden Gelegenheit macht, Fachkenntnisse in einem einzigartigen internationalen Umfeld zu entwickeln.
Ihre Aufgaben:

• Design & Konstruktion von mechanischen Teilen für kundenspezifische physikalische Aufdampfsysteme und zugehörige Werkzeuge.

• Montage von Beschichtungsanordnungen im Ultrahochvakuum.

• Validierung der Beschichtungstechnologie und des Verfahrens (in realen Prototypen mit bis zu 12 Meter langen Balkenrohren).

• Validierung des Vakuumverhaltens der hergestellten Beschichtungen (in Ultra-Hochvakuum-Systemen).
Ihr Profil:

• Erfahrung in der Bearbeitung von Metallteilen in Dreh- und Fräsmaschinen. CNC wäre ein Vorteil.

• Vertrautheit mit der Verwendung von CAD-Software zum Entwerfen mechanischer Teile.

• Praktische Erfahrung in der Montage von mechanischen Geräten.

• Erfahrung in der Vakuumtechnik wäre von Vorteil.
Fähigkeiten:

• Arbeiten in Teams.

• Neugierig und proaktiv.

• Kenntnisse der Vakuumtechnik wären von Vorteil.

• Wissen über Schweißen wäre von Vorteil.

• Gesprochen und geschrieben Englisch oder Französisch, mit der Verpflichtung, die Grundlagen der anderen Sprache zu lernen.
Förderkriterien:

• Sie sind Staatsangehöriger eines CERN-Mitglieds oder assoziierten Mitgliedstaats.

• Bis zum Bewerbungsschluss haben Sie seit dem Abschluss in Maschinenbau (oder einem verwandten Bereich) maximal zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung und Ihre höchste Bildungsqualifikation ist ein allgemeines Sekundarschulabschluss.

• Sie hatten noch nie einen CERN-Stipendiaten- oder Absolventenvertrag.

• Bewerber mit einem Bachelor-, Master- oder PhD-Abschluss sind nicht förderfähig.

Schließungsdatum: 07.12.2026 um 23:59 Uhr MEZ.

Arbeitsplatzflexibilität: Vollständig vor Ort
Startdatum: 01-November-2026
Diese Position umfasst:

• Arbeiten in Strahlungsgebieten.

• Eingriffe in unterirdische Anlagen.

• Ein gültiger Führerschein.

• Arbeiten in den Nächten, Sonntagen und offiziellen Feiertagen, wenn es die Bedürfnisse der Organisation erfordern.

Arbeitsgebiet: Maschinenbau

• Ein monatliches Stipendium von 4687 Schweizer Franken pro Monat (steuerfrei).

• Familien-, Kinder- und Säuglingszulagen, abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

• Ein Umzugspaket (Installationszuschuss und Reisekosten), abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

• Möglichkeit, Ihren Vertrag bis zu 36 Monate zu verlängern.

Bei CERN, der Europäischen Organisation für Kernforschung, erweitern wir die Grenzen von Wissenschaft und Technologie. Unsere bahnbrechende Arbeit bringt nicht nur Physiker zusammen, sondern auch eine Vielzahl von Fachleuten aus den Bereichen Ingenieurwesen, Technik, Wissenschaft und Verwaltung. Gemeinsam fördern wir ein Umfeld, in dem Innovation und Zusammenarbeit gedeihen.

Wir begegnen diesen Herausforderungen durch die vielfältigen Perspektiven in unseren Teams, stellen sicher, dass jeder Beitrag wertgeschätzt wird und fördern unser gemeinsames Gefühl von Inklusion und Zweck. Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein zentraler Wert des CERN und bleibt für unsere Mission und unseren anhaltenden Erfolg von zentraler Bedeutung.

Le CERN prépare le futur projet de collision circulaire (FCC) pour approbation éventuelle par le Conseil du CERN en 2028/29. L'importance et la taille du projet de FAC exigent une campagne de communication à l'échelle locale à l'échelle internationale, impliquant la population voisine du CERN, le grand public, la communauté scientifique et les décideurs. Le CERN cherche donc un professionnel expérimenté pour diriger la campagne de communication de FAC, mettre en oeuvre une stratégie de communication et d'engagement et coordonner la création de contenu et sa prestation aux divers intervenants.
Ce rôle comprendra une réflexion stratégique, un leadership solide ainsi que d'excellentes compétences en matière d'exécution.
Fonctions

• Être responsable de la mise en oeuvre d'une stratégie globale de communication et d'engagement.

• Diriger la planification et l'exécution des campagnes, gérer les messages entre les canaux et assurer des communications claires, cohérentes et efficaces pour divers auditoires.

• Coordonner le développement du contenu et des produits, travailler en étroite collaboration avec le Bureau de projet de FAC et les équipes techniques et, les interfaces avec les intervenants externes, ainsi qu'avec les écrivains, les producteurs multimédias et l'équipe des médias et du numérique.

• Gérer les relations avec les chefs de projet et les divers intervenants.

• Anticiper et gérer les risques et les problèmes de réputation.

• Appuyer les activités locales et publiques liées au projet de FAC.

• Surveiller, évaluer et rendre compte du rendement de la campagne.

• Gérer les contrats potentiels avec des entreprises externes, diriger et soutenir le personnel de communication et les consultants au besoin.

Maîtrise ou doctorat ou expérience équivalente pertinente dans le domaine de la communication ou du marketing ou dans un domaine connexe.

Expérience :

• Expérience éprouvée des cadres supérieurs dans les campagnes de communication à grande échelle ou d'engagement du public.

• Expérience de travail dans des projets complexes, très médiatisés ou dans des environnements multipartites et scientifiques.

• Expérience démontrée dans la gestion efficace des projets et l'obtention de résultats sous pression.

• Expérience des communications numériques, des médias et des intervenants.
Compétences techniques:

• Planification stratégique des communications, y compris la mise en œuvre d'une vision.

• Gestion de projet.

• Communication scientifique.

• Gestion des relations avec les intervenants et engagement communautaire.

• Processus participatifs et techniques de dialogue communautaire.
Compétences comportementales :

• Démontrer la responsabilisation : utiliser comme il convient les ressources de l'Organisation.

• Créer une vision et des partenariats stratégiques : faire preuve de respect, de diplomatie et de tact avec des partenaires externes.

Excellent anglais parlé et écrit avec une bonne connaissance pratique du français.
